title: Distance form of a JL embedding
statement:
Let $0 < \varepsilon < 1$, let $V$ be a finite set of points in $\bbr^d$, and let $f : \bbr^d \to \bbr^k$ be a linear map that is an $\varepsilon$-JL embedding of $V$, so that for every pair $u, v \in V$ one has $(1-\varepsilon)\,\|u-v\|^2 \le \|f(u)-f(v)\|^2 \le (1+\varepsilon)\,\|u-v\|^2$. Then for all $u, v \in V$,
\[
  \sqrt{1-\varepsilon}\,\|u - v\| \;\le\; \|f(u) - f(v)\| \;\le\; \sqrt{1+\varepsilon}\,\|u - v\|.
\]
hypotheses_covered: V a finite set of points in ℝ^d
f a linear map ℝ^d → ℝ^k
f is an ε-JL embedding of V (two-sided squared-distance bound)
replaced:
If $f$ is an $\varepsilon$-JL embedding of $V$ (in the squared-distance sense),
then for all $u, v \in V$,
\[
  \sqrt{1-\varepsilon}\,\|u - v\| \;\le\; \|f(u) - f(v)\| \;\le\;
  \sqrt{1+\varepsilon}\,\|u - v\|,
\]
obtained by taking square roots of the \texttt{JLDistortion} bounds.
